fields.name: navigation-title
fields.label: Navigation Title
fields.description: Optional. Used as a shorter label in navigation surfaces such as breadcrumbs.

fields.name: breadcrumb-title
fields.label: Breadcrumb Title
fields.description: Optional. Overrides Navigation Title and page title when this page appears in breadcrumbs.

fields.name: breadcrumb-visible
fields.label: Include in Breadcrumb
fields.description: When disabled, this page is skipped when it is used as an intermediate breadcrumb level.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this section in the Content Tree

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Table Style
fields.description: Select one or more presentation options for the table.

fields.name: videoDam
fields.label: Video DAM
fields.description: Select an AEM DAM video reference or contribute a direct video URL.

fields.name: homeLabel
fields.label: Home Label
fields.description: Optional. If empty, the block uses the breadcrumbHome placeholder/i18n value.

fields.name: homeUrl
fields.label: Home URL
fields.description: Optional. If empty, the block links to the Inspiration Guide root for the current locale.

fields.name: currentLabel
fields.label: Current Page Label
fields.description: Optional. If empty, the block uses the page title or the current URL segment.

fields.name: filterCategory
fields.label: Filter Category (Auto by Category / Category variant)

fields.name: tag_layout
fields.label: Card Layout
fields.description: Choose Horizontal for article content or Vertical for recommended hotel grids.

fields.name: tag_tagLabel
fields.label: Promotional Badge
fields.description: Optional badge shown over the image in the vertical variant, for example Offer or Recommended.

fields.name: background_errorGenericMessage
fields.label: Generic error message
fields.value: Ha habido un error. Por favor, inténtalo de nuevo más tarde.

fields.name: background_errorEmailMessage
fields.label: Email error message
fields.value: Por favor, introduce una dirección de correo electrónico válida

fields.name: background_errorCheckMessage
fields.label: Checkbox error message
fields.value: Por favor, acepta nuestros Términos y Condiciones.

fields.name: background_successMessage
fields.label: Success message
fields.value: Revisa tu bandeja de correo para confirmar tu email.

fields.name: viewAllText
fields.label: View all - text
fields.description: Text for the 'view all' link shown at the end of the submenu when this item has Nav Item Child entries (e.g. 'Ver todos los destinos').

fields.name: viewAllLink
fields.label: View all - link
fields.description: Link for the 'view all' link shown when this item has Nav Item Child entries.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: Enter just the locale code (es-es, en-us, fr-fr…) to auto-link to that language's Inspiration Guide home, or provide a full path/URL.

fields.name: gridCta_link
fields.label: CTA URL
fields.description: Use an absolute URL for AEM pages outside this EDS site or for external destinations.

fields.name: hotelCode
fields.label: Hotel Code
fields.description: GraphQL hotel code to fetch data from

fields.name: destination
fields.label: Destination
fields.description: Override destination text for this hotel card

fields.name: cta_link
fields.label: Hotel URL
fields.description: Optional override URL for this hotel card title link

fields.name: tag_tagLabel
fields.label: Promotional Badge
fields.description: Optional badge shown over the hotel image (e.g. "hasta un 20%")

fields.name: gridCta_link
fields.label: CTA URL
fields.description: Use an absolute URL for AEM pages outside this EDS site or for external destinations.

fields.name: tag_tagLabel
fields.label: Promotional Badge
fields.description: Optional badge shown over the hotel image.

fields.name: tagParentPage
fields.label: Tag Parent Page
fields.description: Select any EDS page or contribute an absolute URL for a page outside this EDS site.
